# Generator for chart-three-{before,after}.xlsx (openpyxl): three charts on one sheet; after, chart 2 is a column chart with the same title and chart 3 is retitled.
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, LineChart, Reference

def book(kind2, title3):
    wb = Workbook(); ws = wb.active; ws.title = "Data"
    ws.append(["m", "rev", "cost"])
    for i in range(1, 5): ws.append([i, i * 10, i * 7])
    for n, (cls, title, at) in enumerate([(LineChart, "First chart", "F2"), (kind2, "Second chart", "F20"), (LineChart, title3, "F38")]):
        c = cls(); c.title = title
        c.add_data(Reference(ws, min_col=2, max_col=3, min_row=1, max_row=5), titles_from_data=True)
        ws.add_chart(c, at)
    return wb

book(LineChart, "Third chart").save("chart-three-before.xlsx")
book(BarChart, "Third chart 2026").save("chart-three-after.xlsx")
